claims: The 2026 NCAA Men’s March Madness First Four will be held on Tuesday, March 17, and Wednesday, March 18, at the University of Dayton Arena in Dayton, Ohio.
The 2026 NCAA Men’s March Madness First Four consists of four games.
The four games of the 2026 NCAA Men’s March Madness First Four determine the final teams for the main 64-team bracket.
Miami (Ohio) vs. SMU is a matchup in the 2026 First Four.
Further team matchups for the 2026 First Four will be finalized after Selection Sunday.
The TV channel for the 2026 First Four is TruTV.
The First Four has been a staple of March Madness since 2011.
The tournament's first round follows the First Four on March 19-20.
